items.question: Why did Marvin have to copy his report again?
options: A He forgot to write his name.
B Mrs. North could not read his writing.
C He wrote about the wrong topic.
D He lost his first report.

items.question: What does Mrs. North say being left-handed means?
options: A It means you have royal blood.
B It means you write very fast.
C It means you are very smart.
D It means you will be a teacher.

items.question: What does Marvin write his report about?
options: A A trip to Washington, D.C.
B A school play about a prince.
C A king searching for his lost son.

items.question: Look at the text. What are three things that Marvin and Prince Robert have in common?
Do you think Marvin might really be Prince Robert? Why or why not?
